scanner.fingerprintBytes: committed Git blob bytes (LF, as stored in the repository); verify against an export made with core.autocrlf=false, because CRLF working-tree conversion changes the scanned content digest

approval.scope: source-only static findings; does not grant release, install, mutation, or host tool authorization and does not mark findings as fixed
approval.hardening: 2026-11-09 user-requested redirect fail-closed hardening of the three API access validators; fingerprints regenerated after the change

reviewTriggers: scanner version or wheel identity changes
any fingerprint no longer matches because scanned file bytes changed
destination host or API base changes
authentication method or permission scope changes
a new E1 or LP3 finding appears

gateEffect: Starting with SYP-481, the central Standard v1 gate validates this registry and its baselines; the scanner uses --baseline to suppress exact v2 fingerprint matches, which do not trigger human review or semantic analysis; any nonmatching finding (including changes to file bytes or scanner version) remains subject to the severity policy. Any change to approvals, expiry, baselines, exceptions, or baseline files is treated as a new exception candidate and triggers a semantic scan requiring the human approval process; changing only gateEffect does not trigger it

exceptions.capability: network capability without declared tool scope
exceptions.necessity: The Skill must read and, only after exact user authorization, publish or reconcile Bitbucket pull-request review feedback; omitting allowed-tools preserves AI neutrality under Standard 禮5 because host-specific metadata may be treated as preauthorization and a broad WebFetch declaration would be inaccurate.
exceptions.dataFlow: scripts/Invoke-BitbucketReviewActions.ps1 sends GET requests for exact PR metadata, commits, comments, and tasks, and only after target/action authorization sends POST/PUT/DELETE review comment or task operations to api.bitbucket.org /2.0/repositories/{workspace}/{repository}/pullrequests/{id}; compact outcomes and credential-free receipts are retained.
exceptions.credentials: Basic authentication is assembled in memory from BITBUCKET_EMAIL and BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN read from the process environment or approved secret-store adapter; the exact BITBUCKET_API_BASE_URL is checked, and credentials never enter plan arguments, URLs, receipts, files, logs, or returned results.
exceptions.redirectControl: Assert-ApiUri in scripts/Invoke-BitbucketReviewActions.ps1 requires HTTPS, exact api.bitbucket.org:443, no user info or fragment, and the exact expected path; its HttpClientHandler sets AllowAutoRedirect = false. Pagination next links are revalidated and bounded before reuse.
exceptions.riskAssessment: Network and mutation capability exists without frontmatter tool scope, but it remains inside a script that defaults to preview and requires exact user authorization for remote actions. Central approval atlassian-bitbucket-review-7e8228c retains LP3 as historical-context; this repository record neither replaces that approval nor marks LP3 fixed.
exceptions.compensatingControls: Preview by default, exact target/action authorization, plan and commit validation, exact API URI enforcement, disabled redirects, bounded pagination/retries, read-after-write verification, credential-free receipts, redaction, fingerprint binding, and preservation of the existing central internal-use decision.
